While samples from patients with different clinical conditions were used, the primary objective was to validate the workflow's reproducibility and applicability, not to perform a differential proteomics analysis between disease states. Per the hard rules, sample-prep differences are not reported as treatments, and since no biological perturbation axis is the focus of the MS analysis, the 'un-classified' fallback is used.
